source.notes: Scanned school examination paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. Printed header: 2nd Term Examination 2022-23, Subject : Mathematics, Full Marks : 90, Class - VIII, Time : 2 hrs.; examYear 2023 is the later year of the printed academic year 2022-23 (file name also says 2023). No school name printed. Section A (10×4=40, answer all): 4 marks each from the section heading. Section B (5×10=50): 'Answer any five' of six questions, so the Section B entries add to 60 while the paper total is 90. Items marked (2+2) are split into two 2-mark entries. Page 2 is a heavily degraded scan: several numbers, signs and exponents there are uncertain and flagged. Student pen ticks on page 1 were ignored. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
